LoadCursor@QFormSkin.inc.desc: Loads a cursor resource from a module or a predefined system cursor (IDC_ARROW etc.). Returns the cursor handle, or 0 on failure. Superseded by LoadImage.

mouse_event@QFormSkin.inc.desc: Synthesizes mouse motion and button clicks (dwFlags, dx, dy, data). Superseded; use SendInput instead.

RedrawWindow@QFormSkin.inc.desc: Updates the specified rectangle or region in a window's client area; fuRedraw flags control invalidation, erasing and immediate painting. Returns nonzero on success.

EnumProcesses@RQProcess.inc.desc: Retrieves the process identifier of each process in the system into an array; the third parameter receives the number of bytes returned. Returns nonzero on success.

EnumProcessModules@RQProcess.inc.desc: Retrieves a handle for each module loaded in the specified process into an array; the last parameter receives the bytes needed. Returns nonzero on success.

GetModuleBaseName@RQProcess.inc.desc: Retrieves the base file name of a module loaded in the specified process (module handle 0 = the main executable). Returns the length of the copied string.

OpenProcess@RQProcess.inc.desc: Opens an existing process object by process ID with the requested access rights. Returns a process handle, or 0 on failure; close it with CloseHandle.

TerminateProcess@RQProcess.inc.desc: Terminates the specified process and all its threads, setting the given exit code. Returns nonzero on success.

GetExitCodeProcess@RQProcess.inc.desc: Retrieves the termination status of a process; STILL_ACTIVE (259) is returned while the process is running. Returns nonzero on success.

QDIR_SetFileTime@SetFileTimeAttrib.inc.desc: Sets the creation, last access and last write times of a file or directory, given as FILETIME structures. Returns nonzero on success.

QDIR_SystemTimeToFileTime@SetFileTimeAtt.desc: Converts a SYSTEMTIME structure to FILETIME format (100-ns intervals since 1601, UTC). Returns nonzero on success.

QDIR_CreateFile@SetFileTimeAttrib.inc.desc: Creates or opens a file or I/O device (pipe, volume, console, etc.) with given access, sharing and creation mode. Returns a handle, or INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE (-1) on failure.

QDIR_CloseHandle@SetFileTimeAttrib.inc.desc: Closes an open object handle (file, process, thread, event, pipe, etc.). Returns nonzero on success.

QDIR_SetFileAttributes@SetFileTimeAttrib.desc: Sets the attributes (read-only, hidden, system, archive, etc.) of a file or directory. Returns nonzero on success.

FindExecutable@Shell32.inc.desc: Retrieves the name of the executable associated with the specified document file. Returns a value greater than 32 on success.

SHEmptyRecycleBin@Shell32.inc.desc: Empties the Recycle Bin on the specified drive (or all drives if the root path is empty); flags suppress confirmation, progress UI or sound. Returns S_OK on success.

SHQueryRecycleBin@Shell32.inc.desc: Retrieves the total size and number of items in the Recycle Bin for the specified drive into an SHQUERYRBINFO structure. Returns S_OK on success.

RDR_CreatePipe@ShellRedir.Inc.desc: Creates an anonymous pipe and returns read and write handles to it; often used to redirect a child process's standard I/O. Returns nonzero on success.

RDR_GetStartupInfo@ShellRedir.Inc.desc: Retrieves the STARTUPINFO structure that was specified when the calling process was created.

RDR_CreateProcess@ShellRedir.Inc.desc: Creates a new process and its primary thread; fills a PROCESS_INFORMATION structure with the process and thread handles and IDs. Returns nonzero on success.

RDR_SetWindowText@ShellRedir.Inc.desc: Changes the text of the specified window's title bar or the text of a control. Returns nonzero on success.

RDR_ReadFile@ShellRedir.Inc.desc: Reads data from a file or I/O device (pipe, console, etc.) into a buffer; the number of bytes read is returned through a parameter. Returns nonzero on success.

RDR_SendMessage@ShellRedir.Inc.desc: Sends a message to a window and does not return until the window procedure has processed it. Returns the message-specific result.

RDR_CloseHandle@ShellRedir.Inc.desc: Closes an open object handle (file, process, thread, event, pipe, etc.). Returns nonzero on success.

FindWindow@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves the handle of the top-level window whose class name and window name match the given strings. Returns 0 if not found.

GetActiveWindow@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves the handle of the active window attached to the calling thread's message queue, or 0 if none.

GetCursor@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves a handle to the current cursor, or 0 if there is none.

GetDialogBaseUnits@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves the system's dialog base units (average character width in the low word, height in the high word) based on the system font.

GetDoubleClickTime@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves the current maximum time, in milliseconds, between the clicks of a double-click.

GetForegroundWindow@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves the handle of the foreground window (the window the user is currently working with).

GetInputState@User32.inc.desc: Determines whether there are mouse-button or keyboard messages in the calling thread's message queue. Returns nonzero if there are.

GetKBCodePage@User32.inc.desc: Returns the current OEM code page. Obsolete, provided only for 16-bit compatibility; use GetOEMCP instead.

GetMenuCheckMarkDimensions@User32.inc.desc: Returns the dimensions of the default check-mark bitmap (width in low word, height in high word). Obsolete; use GetSystemMetrics with SM_CXMENUCHECK/SM_CYMENUCHECK.

GetMessageExtraInfo@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves the extra message information for the current thread, an application- or driver-defined value associated with the input message.

GetMessagePos@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves the cursor position, in screen coordinates, at the time the last message from GetMessage was posted (x in low word, y in high word).

GetMessageTime@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves the time, in milliseconds since system start, of the last message retrieved by GetMessage.

GetOpenClipboardWindow@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves the handle of the window that currently has the clipboard open, or 0 if none.

GetProcessWindowStation@User32.inc.desc: Retrieves a handle to the window station associated with the calling process.

GetWindowText_User32@User32.inc.desc: Copies the text of the specified window's title bar (or a control's text) into a buffer. Returns the length of the copied string.

RegisterHotKey@User32.inc.desc: Defines a system-wide hot key (modifiers + virtual key) that posts WM_HOTKEY to the given window. Returns nonzero on success.

UnRegisterHotKey@User32.inc.desc: Frees a hot key previously registered by the calling thread with RegisterHotKey. Returns nonzero on success.

LoadCursorFromFile@WFunctions.inc.desc: Creates a cursor from a .cur or .ani file. Returns the cursor handle, or 0 on failure.

InterlockedIncrement@WIN32API.INC.desc: Increments a 32-bit variable as an atomic operation and returns the resulting value.

InterlockedDecrement@WIN32API.INC.desc: Decrements a 32-bit variable as an atomic operation and returns the resulting value.

InterlockedExchange@WIN32API.INC.desc: Atomically sets a 32-bit variable to the specified value and returns its initial value.

GetModuleFileName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the full path of the file that contains the specified module (0 = the current executable). Returns the length of the copied string.

CreateProcess@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a new process and its primary thread; fills a PROCESS_INFORMATION structure with the process and thread handles and IDs. Returns nonzero on success.

SetProcessShutdownParameters@WIN32API.IN.desc: Sets the shutdown order level of the calling process relative to other processes, and whether the system shows a retry dialog. Returns nonzero on success.

GetProcessShutdownParameters@WIN32API.IN.desc: Retrieves the shutdown level and flags of the calling process. Returns nonzero on success.

FatalAppExit@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays a message box with the given text and terminates the application when it is closed.

GetStartupInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the STARTUPINFO structure that was specified when the calling process was created.

GetEnvironmentVariable@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the value of the specified environment variable of the calling process into a buffer. Returns the length of the value, or 0 if not found.

SetEnvironmentVariable@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets or deletes the value of an environment variable for the current process. Returns nonzero on success.

ExpandEnvironmentStrings@WIN32API.INC.desc: Expands %name% environment-variable references in a string and copies the result to a buffer. Returns the required buffer size in characters.

LoadLibraryEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Loads the specified module (DLL or EXE) into the process; flags can load it as a data file or alter the search path. Returns a module handle, or 0 on failure.

LoadModule@WIN32API.INC.desc: Loads and runs an application. Obsolete, provided for 16-bit compatibility; use CreateProcess instead.

WinExec@WIN32API.INC.desc: Runs the specified application with the given show-window command. Obsolete, provided for 16-bit compatibility; use CreateProcess instead.

DebugBreak@WIN32API.INC.desc: Causes a breakpoint exception in the current process, handing control to a debugger.

ContinueDebugEvent@WIN32API.INC.desc: Lets a debugger continue a thread that previously reported a debugging event. Returns nonzero on success.

DebugActiveProcess@WIN32API.INC.desc: Attaches a debugger to an active process (by process ID) and debugs it. Returns nonzero on success.

InitializeCriticalSection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Initializes a critical section object used for mutual exclusion between threads of one process.

EnterCriticalSection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Waits for ownership of the specified critical section object; returns when the calling thread has been granted ownership.

LeaveCriticalSection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Releases ownership of the specified critical section object.

DeleteCriticalSection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Releases all resources used by an unowned critical section object.

SetEvent@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the specified event object to the signaled state. Returns nonzero on success.

ResetEvent@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the specified event object to the nonsignaled state. Returns nonzero on success.

PulseEvent@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets an event to signaled and then resets it after releasing waiting threads. Microsoft says it is unreliable and should not be used.

ReleaseSemaphore@WIN32API.INC.desc: Increases the count of the specified semaphore object by a given amount and can return the previous count. Returns nonzero on success.

ReleaseMutex@WIN32API.INC.desc: Releases ownership of the specified mutex object. Returns nonzero on success.

WaitForMultipleObjects@WIN32API.INC.desc: Waits until one or all of the specified objects are signaled or the time-out elapses. Returns WAIT_OBJECT_0+index, WAIT_TIMEOUT or WAIT_FAILED.

Sleep@WIN32API.INC.desc: Suspends execution of the current thread for the specified number of milliseconds.

OutputDebugString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a string to the debugger for display.

OpenFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates, opens, reopens or deletes a file using an OFSTRUCT. Obsolete, 16-bit compatibility; use CreateFile instead.

GetTempFileName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a name for a temporary file from a path, prefix and unique number; with uUnique = 0 it also creates the empty file. Returns the unique number used.

SetHandleCount@WIN32API.INC.desc: Has no effect in Win32 and returns the requested number. Obsolete; kept only for 16-bit compatibility.

LockFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Locks the specified byte range of an open file for exclusive access by the calling process. Returns nonzero on success.

UnlockFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Unlocks a byte range of an open file previously locked with LockFile. Returns nonzero on success.

LockFileEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Locks a byte range of an open file for shared or exclusive access, optionally failing immediately instead of waiting. Returns nonzero on success.

UnlockFileEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Unlocks a byte range of an open file previously locked with LockFileEx. Returns nonzero on success.

GetFileInformationByHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves file information (attributes, times, volume serial, size, link count, file index) into a BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION structure. Returns nonzero on success.

GetFileType@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the type of the specified file handle: disk, character (console/printer), pipe, or unknown.

GetFileSize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the size of the specified file; the low 32 bits are returned and the high 32 bits go to an optional parameter. Returns INVALID_FILE_SIZE on failure.

GetStdHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a handle to the standard input, output or error device (STD_INPUT_HANDLE = -10, STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE = -11, STD_ERROR_HANDLE = -12).

SetStdHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the handle for the standard input, output or error device of the process. Returns nonzero on success.

WriteFile_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Writes data from a buffer to a file or I/O device; the number of bytes written is returned through a parameter. Returns nonzero on success.

FlushFileBuffers@WIN32API.INC.desc: Flushes the buffers of a file and causes all buffered data to be written to the device. Returns nonzero on success.

DeviceIoControl@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a control code directly to a device driver, with input and output buffers. Returns nonzero on success.

SetEndOfFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the end of the file (its physical size) to the current position of the file pointer. Returns nonzero on success.

SetFilePointer@WIN32API.INC.desc: Moves the file pointer of an open file by a distance relative to the beginning, current position or end. Returns the new low-order position.

FindClose@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a file search handle opened by FindFirstFile. Returns nonzero on success.

GetFileTime@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the creation, last access and last write times of a file or directory as FILETIME values. Returns nonzero on success.

SetFileTime@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the creation, last access and last write times of a file or directory, given as FILETIME structures. Returns nonzero on success.

DuplicateHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Duplicates an object handle, possibly into another process, with the same or different access. Returns nonzero on success.

GlobalAlloc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Allocates the specified number of bytes from the heap (fixed or movable). Returns a memory handle. Microsoft recommends the heap functions for new code.

GlobalFree@WIN32API.INC.desc: Frees the specified global memory object. Returns 0 on success, or the handle on failure.

GlobalHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the handle of the global memory object associated with a pointer to its first byte.

GlobalLock@WIN32API.INC.desc: Locks a global memory object and returns a pointer to its first byte; for movable memory it increments the lock count.

GlobalReAlloc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes the size or attributes of a global memory object. Returns the handle of the reallocated object, or 0 on failure.

GlobalSize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current size, in bytes, of the specified global memory object.

GlobalUnlock@WIN32API.INC.desc: Decrements the lock count of a movable global memory object locked with GlobalLock.

GlobalFlags@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information (allocation flags and lock count) about the specified global memory object.

LocalAlloc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Allocates the specified number of bytes from the heap (fixed or movable). Returns a memory handle. Microsoft recommends the heap functions for new code.

LocalFree@WIN32API.INC.desc: Frees the specified local memory object. Returns 0 on success, or the handle on failure.

LocalHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the handle of the local memory object associated with a pointer to its first byte.

LocalLock@WIN32API.INC.desc: Locks a local memory object and returns a pointer to its first byte.

LocalReAlloc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes the size or attributes of a local memory object. Returns the handle of the reallocated object, or 0 on failure.

LocalSize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current size, in bytes, of the specified local memory object.

LocalUnlock@WIN32API.INC.desc: Decrements the lock count of a movable local memory object locked with LocalLock.

LocalFlags@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information (allocation flags and lock count) about the specified local memory object.

FlushInstructionCache@WIN32API.INC.desc: Flushes the instruction cache for a process; call it after modifying code in memory. Returns nonzero on success.

VirtualAlloc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Reserves, commits or changes the state of a region of pages in the calling process's virtual address space. Returns the base address, or 0 on failure.

VirtualFree@WIN32API.INC.desc: Releases, decommits, or both, a region of pages in the calling process's virtual address space. Returns nonzero on success.

VirtualProtect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes the access protection of a region of committed pages in the calling process; the old protection is returned through a parameter.

VirtualQuery@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a range of pages in the calling process's address space into a MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION structure. Returns the bytes written.

VirtualProtectEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes the access protection of a region of committed pages in the virtual address space of a specified process. Returns nonzero on success.

VirtualQueryEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a range of pages in the address space of a specified process into a MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION structure.

HeapReAlloc_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Reallocates a block of memory from a heap, changing its size and/or properties. Returns a pointer to the block, or 0 on failure.

HeapFree_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Frees a memory block allocated from a heap by HeapAlloc or HeapReAlloc. Returns nonzero on success.

HeapSize_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the size, in bytes, of a memory block allocated from a heap.

GetProcessTimes@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the creation, exit, kernel-mode and user-mode times of the specified process as FILETIME values. Returns nonzero on success.

GetExitCodeProcess_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the termination status of a process; STILL_ACTIVE (259) is returned while the process is running. Returns nonzero on success.

SetLastErrorEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the last-error code for the calling thread; the dwType parameter is ignored. Microsoft lists it under kernel32 and advises using SetLastError.

GetOverlappedResult@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the result of an overlapped (asynchronous) operation on a file, pipe or device, optionally waiting for it to finish. Returns nonzero on success.

SetDebugErrorLevel@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the minimum error level at which Windows generates debugging events for the debugger. Microsoft says it is not implemented.

SetErrorMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Controls whether the system handles serious errors itself (e.g. critical-error dialogs) or lets the process handle them. Returns the previous error mode.

ReadProcessMemory@WIN32API.INC.desc: Reads data from an area of memory in a specified process (requires PROCESS_VM_READ access). Returns nonzero on success.

WriteProcessMemory@WIN32API.INC.desc: Writes data to an area of memory in a specified process. Returns nonzero on success.

GetThreadContext@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the processor context (registers) of the specified thread into a CONTEXT structure. Returns nonzero on success.

SetThreadContext@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the processor context (registers) of the specified thread from a CONTEXT structure. Returns nonzero on success.

SuspendThread@WIN32API.INC.desc: Suspends the specified thread. Returns the thread's previous suspend count, or -1 on failure.

ResumeThread@WIN32API.INC.desc: Decrements a thread's suspend count; when it reaches zero the thread resumes. Returns the previous suspend count, or -1 on failure.

FindResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines the location of a resource with the given type and name in a module. Returns a resource info handle for LoadResource, or 0.

FindResourceEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines the location of a resource with the given type, name and language in a module. Returns a resource info handle, or 0.

BeginUpdateResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a handle used by UpdateResource to add, delete or replace resources in an executable file. Returns 0 on failure.

UpdateResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds, deletes or replaces a resource in a file opened with BeginUpdateResource. Returns nonzero on success.

EndUpdateResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Commits or discards the resource changes made with UpdateResource. Returns nonzero on success.

LoadResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a handle that can be used to obtain a pointer to a resource found with FindResource.

LockResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a pointer to the specified resource in memory, from a handle returned by LoadResource.

SizeofResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the size, in bytes, of the specified resource. Returns 0 on failure.

InitAtomTable@WIN32API.INC.desc: Initializes the local atom table and sets the number of hash buckets. Returns nonzero on success.

AddAtom@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds a string to the local atom table and returns a unique 16-bit atom value, or 0 on failure.

DeleteAtom@WIN32API.INC.desc: Decrements the reference count of a local string atom; the atom is removed when the count reaches zero. Returns 0 on success.

FindAtom@WIN32API.INC.desc: Searches the local atom table for the given string and returns its atom, or 0 if not found.

GetAtomName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the string associated with the specified local atom. Returns the length of the copied string.

GlobalAddAtom@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds a string to the global atom table and returns a unique 16-bit atom value, or 0 on failure.

GlobalDeleteAtom@WIN32API.INC.desc: Decrements the reference count of a global string atom; the atom is removed when the count reaches zero. Returns 0 on success.

GlobalFindAtom@WIN32API.INC.desc: Searches the global atom table for the given string and returns its atom, or 0 if not found.

GlobalGetAtomName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the string associated with the specified global atom. Returns the length of the copied string.

GetProfileInt@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves an integer for a key in the given section of win.ini (or its registry mapping). Returns nDefault if the key is missing. 16-bit compatibility; use the registry.

GetProfileString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the string for a key in the given section of win.ini (or its registry mapping). Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use the registry.

WriteProfileString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies a string into the given section of win.ini (or its registry mapping). Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use the registry.

GetProfileSection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves all keys and values of the given section of win.ini. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use the registry.

WriteProfileSection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Replaces the keys and values of the given section in win.ini. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use the registry.

GetPrivateProfileInt@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves an integer for a key in the given section of an .ini file. Returns nDefault if the key is missing.

GetPrivateProfileString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a string for a key in the given section of an .ini file into a buffer; returns the default if missing. Returns the number of characters copied.

WritePrivateProfileString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies a string into the given section and key of an .ini file; a null key or value deletes a section or key. Returns nonzero on success.

GetPrivateProfileSection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves all keys and values of the given section of an .ini file as null-separated strings. Returns the number of characters copied.

WritePrivateProfileSection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Replaces the keys and values of the given section in an .ini file. Returns nonzero on success.

GetSystemDirectory@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the path of the system directory (e.g. C:\Windows\System32) into a buffer. Returns the length of the copied string.

SetCurrentDirectory@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes the current directory of the current process. Returns nonzero on success.

GetCurrentDirectory@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current directory of the current process into a buffer; returns its length. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "GetCurrentDirectoryA".

GetDiskFreeSpace_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves sectors per cluster, bytes per sector, free clusters and total clusters for a disk. Limited to 2 GB results; use GetDiskFreeSpaceEx for large disks.

CreateDirectoryEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a new directory with the attributes of a specified template directory. Returns nonzero on success.

RemoveDirectory@WIN32API.INC.desc: Deletes an existing empty directory. Returns nonzero on success.

GetFullPathName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the full path and file name of the specified file (relative to the current directory). Returns the length of the copied string.

DefineDosDevice@WIN32API.INC.desc: Defines, redefines or deletes an MS-DOS device name (such as a drive letter mapped to a path). Returns nonzero on success.

QueryDosDevice@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the target path of an MS-DOS device name, or the list of all device names. Returns the number of characters stored.

CreateFile_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates or opens a file or I/O device (pipe, volume, console, etc.) with given access, sharing and creation mode. Returns a handle, or INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE (-1) on failure.

FindFirstFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Searches a directory for a file or subdirectory matching a name (wildcards allowed), filling WIN32_FIND_DATA. Returns a search handle, or -1 on failure.

FindNextFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Continues a file search started by FindFirstFile, filling WIN32_FIND_DATA with the next match. Returns 0 when no more files are found.

SearchPath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Searches for the specified file along a path (or the standard search order) and returns its full path. Returns the length of the copied string.

MoveFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Moves or renames an existing file or directory. Returns nonzero on success.

MoveFileEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Moves or renames a file or directory with options such as replace existing, copy across volumes, or delay until reboot. Returns nonzero on success.

CreateNamedPipe@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates an instance of a named pipe and returns a server-side handle, or INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE on failure.

GetNamedPipeHandleState@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a named pipe handle (mode, instances, collection settings, client user name). Returns nonzero on success.

CallNamedPipe@WIN32API.INC.desc: Connects to a message-type named pipe, writes a message, reads a reply and closes the pipe. Returns nonzero on success.

WaitNamedPipe@WIN32API.INC.desc: Waits until a time-out elapses or an instance of the named pipe is available for connection. Returns nonzero if available.

SetVolumeLabel@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the label of a file system volume. Returns nonzero on success.

SetFileApisToOEM@WIN32API.INC.desc: Makes the file I/O functions use the OEM code page instead of the ANSI code page for the calling process.

GetVolumeInformation@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a file system volume: label, serial number, maximum component length, flags and file system name. Returns nonzero on success.

ClearEventLog@WIN32API.INC.desc: Clears the specified event log, optionally saving a backup copy first. Returns nonzero on success.

BackupEventLog@WIN32API.INC.desc: Saves the specified event log to a backup file. Returns nonzero on success.

CloseEventLog@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a read handle to an event log opened with OpenEventLog. Returns nonzero on success.

DeregisterEventSource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes an event log handle returned by RegisterEventSource. Returns nonzero on success.

GetNumberOfEventLogRecords@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the number of records in the specified event log. Returns nonzero on success.

GetOldestEventLogRecord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the absolute record number of the oldest record in the specified event log. Returns nonzero on success.

OpenEventLog@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens a handle to the specified event log on a server. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "OpenEventLogA".

RegisterEventSource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a registered handle to the specified event source, used with ReportEvent. Returns 0 on failure.

OpenBackupEventLog@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens a handle to a backup event log file created with BackupEventLog. Returns 0 on failure.

ReadEventLog@WIN32API.INC.desc: Reads entries from an event log, sequentially or from a given record, forwards or backwards. Returns nonzero on success.

ReportEvent@WIN32API.INC.desc: Writes an entry (type, category, event ID, strings, binary data) at the end of the event log for the given event source. Returns nonzero on success.

DuplicateToken@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a new impersonation access token that duplicates an existing token. Returns nonzero on success.

GetKernelObjectSecurity@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a copy of the security descriptor of a kernel object (file, process, event, etc.). Returns nonzero on success.

ImpersonateNamedPipeClient@WIN32API.INC.desc: Makes the calling thread impersonate the client of a named pipe. Returns nonzero on success.

ImpersonateSelf@WIN32API.INC.desc: Obtains an access token impersonating the calling process's security context and attaches it to the calling thread. Returns nonzero on success.

RevertToSelf@WIN32API.INC.desc: Ends the impersonation of a client application by the calling thread. Returns nonzero on success.

AccessCheck@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether a security descriptor grants the requested access rights to the client identified by an impersonation token. Returns nonzero on success.

OpenProcessToken_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens the access token associated with a process. Returns nonzero on success; the token handle is returned through a parameter.
